Apply for a PhD with your own project
Twice a year, you can apply for enrolment with your own project via our ordinary open calls. When there is an ordinary open call, it is advertised here.
In our ordinary open calls, you can apply for enrolment only; enrolment and a faculty fellowship or enrolment and partial funding. Ca. 10 fully financed PhD fellowships are offered each round.
Always consult our application guide to learn about our admission requirements and mandatory elements of the application before you apply! The requirments apply to all applicants.
All PhD applications are evaluated based on the submitted material within the deadline, using the assessment criteria.
When all applications have been assessed, you get a reply to your application (see the timeline below).

Problems submitting your application?
Don't use a tablet or phone, only use a computer.
Make sure all files are pdf.-files.
Make sure the files are max 20 MB.
Try another browser.
Clear your cache.
It can be the internet connection; the system has a "timeout" so if it takes too long to submit the application, you will get an error message.
Be aware that the applications system closes precisely at 24:00 (midnight). If you try to submit an application after that, the application will not be submitted.
Aarhus University
Aarhus University is a leading public research university with global reach. The Faculty of Health offers a vibrant and informal research environment with longstanding traditions for collaboration with the Danish health care sector and with international university partners in the absolute elite.
The university main building is located in the middle of the vibrant student city of Aarhus and nearby is the Aarhus University Hospital.
Aarhus University is committed to career development. As a PhD student, you have access to dedicated supervision, career counselling and an extensive training programme.
Aarhus University strives to be an inclusive workplace that promotes equal opportunities. All interested candidates are encouraged to apply, regardless of their personal background.
A PhD is a full time time-limited position. Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with applicable collective agreement. To be enrolled, you need to document that you have the funding for the entire enrolment period. If your work involve direct contact with children under 15, you need to obtain statements of no previous convictions in respect of children.
Before applying applicants are advised to study the rules and regulations of PhD studies at Graduate School of Health. You can also read more about doing a PhD at Aarhus University here.
